About Us

If you want to discover new and challenging ways to move while unlocking new strengths in a friendly and motivating environment, then we welcome you to Reform Athletica, your new home.

Reform Athletica is a boutique fitness studio inspired by the vibrant fitness scenes of New York, London and LA. Currently located in two locations in Dubai’s Jumeirah 1 and DIFC's ICD Brookfield Place – the studio is located perfectly between the urban city bustle and Dubai’s beautiful beaches.

We are boutique; we are not a gym, and we are not priced like a gym. Our classes are capped at 14 people, depending on the class. We have five signature classes: The Reform Method, MicroForm, RA Strength, Yoga and Sculpt and Burn. Each of our classes are designed to complement one another; between low-intensity, high-intensity, stretching, strength and conditioning - we have it covered. 

Our classes are 45-60 minutes long and we do not distinguish between skill levels; beginners and advanced participants are all equally welcome and no prior experience is required for any class. Our instructors will modify exercises or demonstrate alternatives to ensure that you get the most out of your session, no matter your gender or level of experience.

Our Art

Upon entering either of our studios, you’ll notice we’ve tried to create a space that truly feels like home. The owners, having a long-time passion for art and culture have collected art pieces from around the world for the studio, giving the space a unique flair. There is a story behind every piece – whether it was a personal connection they had that drew them to add it to their collection, or its interpretation is in alignment with our core values as a studio. Whether the former or the latter, each piece is beautiful– from the inside out.

Welcome to Champs Sports Club, where every achievement, whether grand or modest, is honored. Join us as we come together as a united team, celebrating victories in the world of sports and beyond.
Meet Our Founder, Fadi El Khatib
A name synonymous with excellence in basketball across Asia and the Arab Countries. Regarded as the region’s all-time best basketball athlete and a role model, Fadi’s journey began in 1996 when he played his first game in the division-one career. From that moment, he emerged as a powerhouse in the sport and an ambassador for fitness in the Middle East.

Today, Fadi’s passion for sports takes on a different form. He founded Champs Sports Club as a premier fitness desitnation and a breeding ground for professional athletes and fitness enthusiasts with diverse sporting interests. On a day-to-day basis, Fadi and his team of international coaches at Champs Sports Club make it their mission to inspire students, athletes, and staff to strive for greatness in all aspects of life.
